effect_definitions.meaning: declared possible refund of the given order to its original payment destination; not executed, authorized or transitively bounded

slot_definitions.meaning: opaque synthetic payment destination; original-payment denotes only the destination declared in bound context, not a verified payee
synthetic classification label, not a verified sensitivity assessment

quantity_definitions.name: https://example.org/quantities/amount
quantity_definitions.interpretation: integer(value) times 10 to the power -2 USD; input amount_minor uses the same integer and currency convention

unknown_target_rule: exact local effect_id plus exact quantity_name; no known/unknown collision or duplicate target
coverage_support: direct-partial-only; bounded_claim and observed evidence need another supported profile
evidence_support: declaration-only; accepted as a declaration, never as a verified provider observation
io_policy: no network fetches; references are opaque lookup keys in the fixed table, not general URI fragments or file paths
